source: California DMHC Independent Medical Review Determinations (data.ca.gov)
publisher: California Department of Managed Health Care (DMHC)
overturned_definition: Determination == 'Overturned Decision of Health Plan' (IMR reviewer reversed the plan's denial; plan must authorize). The only other value is 'Upheld Decision of Health Plan'.
caveats: Covers only enrollees of California DMHC-licensed health plans (HMOs, some PPOs, and many Medi-Cal managed care plans). It does not cover Medicare or Medicare Advantage benefits, CDI-regulated health insurance policies (CDI runs a separate IMR program), self-funded employer (ERISA) plans, or workers' compensation.

Only completed IMR determinations appear (the Determination column has just two values). Denials the plan reversed on its own before a decision, ineligible or withdrawn requests, and internal-appeal outcomes are not represented, so these rates are not the odds of winning a first-level plan appeal.
Selection effect: patients/providers choose which denials to escalate, so the overturn rate reflects contested cases, not all denials.
Rates vary substantially by year and by Type (Experimental/Investigational vs Medical Necessity); see by_type, by_year and segments.*.recent. All-time overturn rate is 52.5%, but 2022-2026 is 66.3%.
2026 is a partial year (CSV resource last modified 2026-10-08; 538 cases so far).
Segment membership is a text filter on the Findings narrative (see each segment's filter); TreatmentCategory/SubCategory coding is inconsistent across years and changed scheme around 2025-2026.
Example findings are the first ~600 characters of the public Findings text, HTML entities decoded and whitespace collapsed; truncation marked with an ellipsis.
39 exact-duplicate rows (identical in every column, including ReferenceID) were removed before counting.

cgm.label: Continuous glucose monitors / diabetes supplies
cgm.filter: Case-level text filter on the request clause of Findings ('has requested ... for X'): X names a CGM or glucose-monitoring product (continuous glucose, CGM/CGMS, Dexcom, FreeStyle Libre/Navigator, Guardian sensor, Enlite, Eversense, glucose monitor/meter/sensor, glucose test strips, HCPCS A9276/A9277). Insulin pumps/pods count only when the same request also names a CGM. For older narrative-format records with no usable request clause: TreatmentSubCategory in {Cont Glucose Monitor, Glucose Monitor, Diabetic Supplies} and Findings mention those terms. TreatmentSubCategory alone is not used for modern records because it is noisy (e.g., Ozempic and insulin pumps filed under Glucose Monitor).

facet.label: Facet joint injections / spinal pain procedures
facet.filter: Request clause of Findings names a facet-joint or medial-branch interventional procedure: facet joint injection/block, medial branch block, facet/medial-branch radiofrequency ablation, neurolysis, rhizotomy, denervation, zygapophyseal joint injection. Excludes facetectomy, facet arthroplasty/replacement (TOPS), and anesthesia-only requests. Epidural steroid injections are NOT included (see by_treatment Pain Management / Epidural Injection).

mri.label: MRI / diagnostic imaging
mri.filter: Request clause of Findings names diagnostic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI, MRA, MR neurography, MR spectroscopy, MRCP) and the case is categorized as imaging (TreatmentCategory Diag Imag & Screen or Radio Proc, or TreatmentSubCategory MRI) or MR imaging is the first item requested. Older narrative-format records: TreatmentSubCategory MRI and Findings mention MRI. Excludes MR-guided therapies (focused ultrasound, guided injections/ablation/radiotherapy), MRI-compatible devices, NMR lipid tests, and anesthesia-for-MRI requests. Other imaging (CT, PET, etc.) is in by_treatment.
